title: Alƙawari da aka Faɗa Game da Gashin Gashi
intro: Kana tsaye kusa da wutar hamada yayin da garwashinta ke yaɗuwa a hankali. Baƙi sun iso don ganawa a cikin shiru, sai saƙo guda ya buɗe labarin alkawari, mamaki, da kuma makomar da ba a cika ba tukuna.
clues: Mun ketare tazara don isa ga wani amintaccen bawa a cikin hamada.
Mun nemi a baza garwashin wuta domin shirya wuta.
Mun yi magana da wani wanda ya yi kira ga harshen wuta don a kwantar da hankali da kuma aminci.
Mun kawo labarin jariri ga wanda ya wuce shekarun haihuwa.
Mun sanya wa yaron da aka yi wa alkawari suna Ishaku.
Mun yi wa Ibrahim albishir da ɗa, kuma labarin mai ban mamaki ya bar Ibrahim yana dariya.
